notes:
Direct GitHub updates for Android and Android-based Fire TV devices.

- Added App updates in Settings and on Home, with optional daily checks.
- Added cancellable downloads, progress and storage checks.
- Rejects corrupt APKs, unexpected download origins, wrong app identities,
  mismatched signing certificates and older versions.
- Uses the Android system installer for explicit installation confirmation.
- Blocks opening installation while a recording is active or finalising.
- Retains the existing package and signing identity for in-place upgrades.

Install this updater-enabled version manually once. Keep your existing LOSTAR
installation in place. Finish or cancel the system installer before scheduled
recordings start. Device smoke-testing remains necessary; host tests cannot
prove compatibility with every Samsung/Fire OS version or stream provider.
